about_the_game:
Imagine a realm filled with limitless possibilities.

Spend your time creating untold imaginings, giving them a world to live, and sharing that world with those around you! 

In "what is that thing? Game of Loure", there are hundreds of thousands of worlds, millions of Things (TM) – all potentially created by the users. No matter what you’re into, there’s a realm in "What is that thing?" for you. And if there isn’t, you can find the tools you need to create your own adventure by logging in below!

[6EQUJ]

Wow!

1: a: Go to any generative AI and use the Prompt "What is that thing?"

AND/OR

b: Create of your own mind using the Prompt "What is that thing?"

2: Post any of or all of the things you create any where!

3: repeat and observe! (The observe part is the most exciting if you know what to look for ;3)

That's it! AI not required! #showmeyourthing #whatisthatthing #letsplaywhatisthatthing #whatisthatthinggameofloure

Wow!

[6EQUJ]

[Note: The "Login" above is not part of the standalone game "WITT?GoL" itself BUT is part of the greater dynamic game of "What is that thing?". The "Game of Loure" is a primary packaging and launch pad for WITT and is itself a unique game of chronicles and mystery that WILL have periodic updates to include but not limited to chat rooms, MMO features, daily, weekly, monthly quests, etc. Or expect that sorta stuff in the sequel.]

Features

Action RPG, side quests, scavenger hunts, and lore....its a game of lore (bane of Josh LGIO)....through exploration. You just need to be intrigued enough to go play "What is that thing?" ......

"In the course of our existence permeated an ever present entity. What is that thing?

That calls your name, that lurks in the shadows. Is right in front of your face THERE IT IS RUN!!! Or ask it a question. 

You and your friend are headed to a concert in a small village across the valley and when morning rises you head out of the small Inn and towards the next town. Unbeknownst to you and the locals in the area a great shift has shook the realm and you find yourself in an unknown plane of existence. SO grab your battle axe, grab your pen and sally forth! 

Who will you find? What will you see?

Join the experimental adventure, journaling, mind game that is "What is that thing? Game of Loure"."

content_descriptors.notes: Game explores concepts of grieving, loss, and acceptance of loss through its loose story telling and abstract game play.
